string.text: Stalkers stay on their feet at low health instead of lying wounded.
Unchecking story exclusion may conflict with quest scripts that rely on wounded state. Monolith exclusion preserves their wounded suicide grenade behavior.
Stalkers treat you as unarmed for meet/warning checks while your weapon is out. Toggles off instantly via MCM.
Blocks engine retreat and panic-flee on non-companion stalkers. Applies on spawn and when changed in MCM.
Same flee block for companions (npcx_is_companion). Does not affect companion follow/catch-up movement.
Turning this off restores panic threshold on living NPCs; retreat blocks clear on respawn.
